articles.title: GST collections surge to record high of Rs 2.43 lakh cr in April
articles.summary: India's Gross GST collection achieved a record high of approximately Rs 2.43 lakh crore in April, marking an 8.7% increase. This significant growth was predominantly fueled by import-led revenues, which outpaced domestic transactions. This robust performance, based on government data, indicates strong economic activity and fiscal health, providing key insights into national economic trends.

articles.title: 73 Comic Shops With Free Comic Book Day 2026 Events Tomorrow
articles.summary: Tomorrow marks Free Comic Book Day 2026, with 73 comic shops worldwide, largely in America, hosting special events. This annual celebration aims to promote comic readership globally, offering enthusiasts giveaways and unique opportunities. The widespread participation underscores its significance as an international cultural event, connecting fans and introducing new titles.

articles.title: Nintendo Switch 2 Leak Reveals Return of 2010s 3DS Series
articles.summary: Recent leaks indicate the upcoming Nintendo Switch 2 console is expected to revive a popular 2010s 3DS game series, last seen in 2019. This news is generating excitement among Nintendo fans, who recall the 3DS fondly despite its varied game catalogue. The potential return highlights Nintendo's strategy to blend nostalgia with new hardware, offering familiar franchises on its next-generation platform.

articles.title: Jenna Bush Hager’s Emotional On-Air Moment Will Resonate With Every Parent
articles.summary: Jenna Bush Hager, a prominent media personality, expressed emotional sentiments on air this week. She conveyed a desire for increased family time with her children, highlighting the challenges of balancing a demanding professional career with personal life. This reflects common modern work-life balance struggles experienced by many, even those in public life.

articles.title: The week Charles pulled off a diplomatic triumph - and stepped out of the late Queen's shadow
articles.summary: The article suggests that King Charles has effectively dispelled any initial doubts regarding his ability to manage the demanding Royal duties. It highlights his recent demonstrations of confidence and charisma, indicating he has proven himself capable on the global stage over the past few days. This early assessment emphasizes his strong leadership qualities in his royal role.

articles.title: My Adventures With Superman Spin-Off Will Be Heavily Influenced by Anime
articles.summary: "My Adventures With Superman" has confirmed its third season will premiere on June 13th this summer. The popular Adult Swim animated series will bring back the Man of Steel, with the upcoming season promising new adventures and challenges for Clark Kent as he continues to develop his powers and protect the world. Fans eagerly await its return.
